verdict.rationale: Rollbar has a first-party MCP server setup page (docs-18, confirmed by probe-3). It describes a stdio server that AI tools such as Claude or Cursor run directly (docs-60), so an agent can connect through an official MCP server. Missing for 10: documentation of which tools and data the MCP server exposes, any hosted or remote (non-stdio) endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
